title_en: Bald Eagle Live-Stream Favorite Diagnosed with Anaemia
title_zh: 秃鹰直播明星被诊断患贫血症
summary_zh: 一只因在加利福尼亚州鸟巢直播中担任主角而全球闻名的秃鹰已被诊断出贫血症。该消息已由其直播项目的关注者确认，引发对这只鸟类健康状况的担忧。
reading_passage: The bald eagle, who has gained worldwide fame as the protagonist of a nest live-stream in California, has been diagnosed with anaemia.

difficult_sentences.sentence: The bald eagle, who has gained worldwide fame as the protagonist of a nest live-stream in California, has been diagnosed with anaemia.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 本句包含一个非限制性定语从句“who has gained...California”，用于补充说明秃鹰的背景信息；主句为“The bald eagle has been diagnosed with anaemia”。非限制性从句通常用逗号隔开，关系代词who指代先行词eagle，提供附加信息。
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 那只因作为加利福尼亚一个鸟巢直播的主角而在全球成名的秃鹰，已被诊断出贫血症。

difficult_sentences.sentence: The bald eagle, who has gained worldwide fame as the protagonist of a nest live-stream in California, has been diagnosed with anaemia.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 从句和主句均使用现在完成时（has gained, has been diagnosed），强调动作发生在过去但对现在有影响或与现在相关——秃鹰的成名是持续至今的状态，诊断结果则是刚刚得知。
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 那只因作为加利福尼亚一个鸟巢直播的主角而在全球成名的秃鹰，已被诊断出贫血症。

difficult_sentences.sentence: The bald eagle, who has gained worldwide fame as the protagonist of a nest live-stream in California, has been diagnosed with anaemia.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 主句为被动语态“has been diagnosed with anaemia”，表示秃鹰是承受诊断行为的对象，施动者（兽医等）未提及，这是新闻英语中常见的句式，以突出事件主体。
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 那只因作为加利福尼亚一个鸟巢直播的主角而在全球成名的秃鹰，已被诊断出贫血症。

difficult_sentences.sentence: The bald eagle, who has gained worldwide fame as the protagonist of a nest live-stream in California, has been diagnosed with anaemia.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 介词短语“as the protagonist of a nest live-stream”作状语，说明秃鹰以何种身份或角色出名。`as` 表示“作为”，引导身份说明。
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 那只因作为加利福尼亚一个鸟巢直播的主角而在全球成名的秃鹰，已被诊断出贫血症。

idioms.usage_note: 常用于描述个人、地点或事物突然获得国际关注，较正式，多用于新闻报道。
idioms.example: The small town gained worldwide fame after the film was released.

idioms.meaning_zh: 以主角身份；作为主要角色
idioms.usage_note: 多用于叙事或报道中，指某人处于事件中心，可比喻非虚构情境。
idioms.example: The journalist found herself as the protagonist of a controversy she was covering.

idioms.usage_note: 医学语境中的固定搭配，后接疾病名称，被动形式常见。
idioms.example: After several tests, he was diagnosed with a rare lung condition.
